pr_title: Propagate request context via persistent streams.

issue_context.title: Persistent stream providers do not store Request Context
issue_context.body:
Request Context is not passed to the subscription by persistent stream provider - Azure Queue.
This works for `SimpleStreamProvider`

review_comments:
We have an open issue regarding not passing the token into the adapter in these calls.  If we're going to incur the cost of a change to a public api we may as well make both changes at once, rather than having two breaking changes.
Agree. After we accept this PR, I will fix the other issue as well. So next public release will have both.
